exposure: Women with multiple sclerosis exposed to glatiramer acetate
Women with multiple sclerosis unexposed to disease-modifying therapies
finding: Glatiramer acetate exposure during the first trimester of pregnancy appears safe and without teratogenic effect.
mod_finding: The study found no increase in Cesarean sections in women with multiple sclerosis exposed to glatiramer acetate during pregnancy compared to those unexposed to disease-modifying therapies.
